# @sessionwise/opencode-plugin

Capture opencode coding sessions into [SessionWise](https://sessionwise.dev) — the organizational memory layer for AI-assisted development.

This plugin forwards tool executions, user messages, and session lifecycle events from opencode to your local `sessionwise` CLI, which handles buffering, encryption, and sync.

## Prerequisites

1. Install the SessionWise CLI and run `sessionwise login`
2. Have opencode installed (`opencode --version`)

## Install

```bash
sessionwise hooks install --target opencode
```

This adds the plugin to your project's `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["@sessionwise/opencode-plugin"]
}
```

opencode runs `bun install` for declared plugins at startup, so no manual `npm install` is needed.

## What gets captured

| opencode event | SessionWise event |
| --- | --- |
| first `chat.message` per session | `session_start` |
| every `chat.message` | `user_prompt` |
| `tool.execute.after` (success) | `tool_use` |
| `tool.execute.after` (explicit error) | `tool_error` |
| `session.idle` / `session.deleted` / `session.error` | `session_end` |

Error classification uses `output.metadata.error` and `output.metadata.status === "error"`. No heuristics on message text.

## Privacy

- All data passes through the local `sessionwise` CLI — the plugin itself never makes network requests.
- Payloads are written to a local JSONL queue and synced to your SessionWise org encrypted at rest.
- If the CLI is not installed or not on `$PATH`, the plugin silently no-ops (never blocks opencode).

## Uninstall

```bash
sessionwise hooks uninstall --target opencode
```
